_comment: #330 SRM download (srm_collector.py). Screen texts / selectors only - addresses stay in .env (SRM_PORTAL_URL; SRM_BASE_URL = SRM host root, recommended (user 11/12 20:38): SRM is then opened directly at <SRM_BASE_URL>/<srm_home_path> without the portal, and screens as <SRM_BASE_URL>/<id>; if that shows no Delivery Date the menu path is used). menu_texts = menu path (without SRM_BASE_URL, or as fallback). After a --probe run, fix the texts / selectors here (no code change). Probe 11/13 06:42: the SRM screens are DevExtreme - the date box shows MM/DD/YYYY and has no label link (label 'delivery date' in lower case, matched in any case; value_fallback = the visible text input holding a date), the search button reads 'inquiry'. Probe 06:48: a date typed while the screen still shows 'Loading...' is wiped - the collector now waits until no busy_selectors element is visible (and the network is idle) before it touches the date, and leaves the date alone when the box already shows it. srm_login = SRM's own login form (user 11/12 20:27: same account as WMS; .env SRM_USERNAME/SRM_PASSWORD, else WMS_USERNAME/WMS_PASSWORD; one try per run, a failure blocks later runs until logs/srm_login_blocked.json is deleted).
